BombVault 7.11.0 lets each off-site target use its own S3/restic-REST credentials instead of sharing one global set.

## ✨ Added

- **Named, per-target S3/restic-REST credential sets.** Issue [#141](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/141) (manilx): until now every off-site target shared one global credential set, so two targets on different S3-compatible backends (a Hetzner bucket and a local Garage server, for example) couldn't run side by side. Settings → Off-site → **Cloud credential sets** now lets you create named sets, and each additional off-site target's editor gets a dropdown to pick which set it uses (or fall back to the shared default). An unknown or deleted reference falls back to the shared credentials rather than failing the target outright.
